literal.prompt: Какое арктическое море простирается от северных побережий Норвегии и России до Новой Земли на востоке?

finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NPI identifies the Barents Sea and places its southern boundary along northern Norway and Russia; NOAA names the Arctic Ocean as smallest; Australian Antarctic Program locates the Weddell and Ross sea sectors relative to the Transantarctic Mountains.
finalGroupBindings.locator: NPI L0-L2; NOAA L4-L10; AAP L305-L307

finalGroupBindings.literal: Это Баренцево море. Его южная граница проходит у берегов Северной Норвегии и России; атлантические воды движутся здесь на восток и север.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NPI says Atlantic water flows eastward and northward and that its supply makes parts of the Barents Sea comparatively accessible for most of the year. The revised sentence states only the supported direction of flow, not a claim that the sea is ice-free.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Баренцево море простирается на север до 80° северной широты.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NPI places the south coast of the Barents Sea at northern Norway and Russia and its eastern extent at Novaya Zemlya.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Северный Ледовитый океан — самый маленький из пяти океанических бассейнов Земли.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: NOAA explicitly identifies the Arctic Ocean as the smallest of the five ocean basins.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Юго-западный угол моря Уэдделла примыкает к Трансантарктическим горам.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: Australian Antarctic Program places the southwestern corner of the Weddell Sea at the Transantarctic Mountains.

finalGroupBindings.literal: Трансантарктические горы доходят до северо-западного угла моря Росса.
finalGroupBindings.primaryGround: Australian Antarctic Program places the northwestern corner of the Ross Sea at the Transantarctic Mountains.
